kanto.flavorText: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

original-johto.flavorText: This tough POKéMON always stays in the zone. Its muscles become thicker after every battle.

hoenn.flavorText: A belt is worn by a MACHOKE to keep its overwhelming power under control. Because it is so dangerous, no one has ever removed the belt.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It can lift a dump truck with one hand. Using that power, it helps people with heavy jobs.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.

updated-johto.flavorText: The muscles covering its body teem with power. Even when still, it exudes an amazing sense of strength.

original-unova.flavorText: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.

updated-unova.flavorText: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.

kalos.flavorText: It can lift a dump truck with one hand. Using that power, it helps people with heavy jobs.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Machoke undertakes bodybuilding every day even as it helps people with tough, physically demanding labor. On its days off, this Pokémon heads to the fields and mountains to exercise and train.

original-alola.flavorText: It willingly assists with hard labor because it knows the work is good training for its muscles.

updated-alola.flavorText: A popular motif for sculptures, its incredibly well-developed muscles have captured the imagination of many an artist.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: The belt around its waist holds back its energy. Without it, this Pokémon would be unstoppable.

swsh.flavorText: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.
